results.expression: 1 + PIANO_IMPACT_PRESENCE_GAIN * exp(-.5 * normalized_x * normalized_x)

results.name: bridge_participation_db.phase
results.expression: TWO_PI * (midi - 21) / 87

results.name: create_hammer_force.skew
results.expression: lerp(.18, -.08, velocity)

results.name: create_string_modes.width_cents
results.expression: lerp(.32, 4.1 * PIANO_UNISON_WIDTH_SCALE, pow(clamp((midi - 31) / 77, 0, 1), 1.5))

results.name: create_string_modes.unison_inequality
results.expression: pow(reg, 1.5)

results.name: create_string_modes.strike_coupling
results.expression: .2 + .8 * fabs(sin(PI * partial * strike_position))

results.name: create_string_modes.felt_filter
results.expression: bell(dispersed_frequency, 0, brightness_cutoff, 1.3)

results.name: create_string_modes.velocity_brightening
results.expression: pow(hammer_velocity_base, log2(partial))

results.name: create_string_modes.radiation
results.expression: PIANO_RADIATION_FLOOR + (1 - PIANO_RADIATION_FLOOR) * dispersed_frequency / (dispersed_frequency + PIANO_RADIATION_CORNER)

results.name: create_string_modes.mid_bridge_coupling
results.expression: 1 + 2.1 * bell(midi, 65, 10, 2) * bell(partial, 2, .75, 2)

results.name: create_string_modes.treble_mode_damping
results.expression: exp(-4.4 * pow(reg, 4.2) * (partial - 1) * treble_loss * lerp(1, .45, middle_broadening))

results.name: create_string_modes.bridge_presence_shape
results.expression: bell(log(dispersed_frequency / 1800), 0, .29, 2)

results.name: create_string_modes.bridge_presence_gain
results.expression: 1 + .7 * middle_presence * bridge_presence_shape

results.name: create_string_modes.bridge_antiresonance_shape
results.expression: bell(log(dispersed_frequency / 790), 0, .08, 2)

results.name: create_string_modes.bridge_antiresonance
results.expression: 1 - .85 * middle_presence * bridge_antiresonance_shape

results.name: create_string_modes.middle_body_shape
results.expression: bell(partial, 4.5, 1, 4)

results.name: create_string_modes.middle_body_level
results.expression: 1 - .5 * middle_presence * middle_body_shape

results.name: create_string_modes.bass_overtone_radiation
results.expression: 1 + 4 * bass_voicing * (1 - exp(-(partial - 1) / 1.6))

results.name: create_string_modes.weak_bass_fundamental
results.expression: 1 - (.91 - .4 * bass_voicing) * bass_voicing * bell(partial, 1, .55, 4)

results.name: create_string_modes.weak_bass_second
results.expression: 1 - (.93 - .4 * bass_voicing) * bass_voicing * bell(partial, 2, .55, 4)

results.name: create_string_modes.bass_high_partial_transition
results.expression: transition((partial - 10) / 7.0)

results.name: create_string_modes.bass_high_partial_radiation
results.expression: 1 + 4.5 * bass_voicing * bass_high_partial_transition

results.name: create_string_modes.bass_presence_radiation
results.expression: 1 + 4 * (1 - bass_broadening) * bass_presence_shape

results.name: create_string_modes.highres_color_db
results.expression: clamp(PIANO_HIGHRES_RADIATION_SCALE * (highres_radiation_db(voice, dispersed_frequency) - voice->highres_anchor), -24, 24)

results.name: create_string_modes.bass_presence_decay
results.expression: transition(log2(dispersed_frequency / 500) / 2)

results.name: create_string_modes.localized_termination_loss
results.expression: PIANO_C6_SECOND_LOSS_DB_PER_SECOND * c6_mode_shape

results.name: create_string_modes.low_order_treble_tail
results.expression: bell(partial, 1.5, 1, 4)

results.name: create_string_modes.treble_high_partial_tail
results.expression: 1 - exp(-(partial - 1) / 2.5)

results.name: create_string_modes.late_treble_tail
results.expression: transition((midi - 94) / 14)

results.name: create_string_modes.middle_low_mode_loss
results.expression: (.3 * middle_presence + .4 * bell(midi, 60, 1.5, 2) * transition((velocity - .8) / .17)) * bell(partial, 1.5, .8, 4)

results.name: create_string_modes.middle_body_sustain
results.expression: .38 * middle_presence * middle_body_shape

results.name: create_string_modes.vertical_second_partial_boost
results.expression: partial == 2 ? 1 + 4.5 * pow(reg, 3) * velocity : 1

results.name: create_string_modes.bass_damper_node
results.expression: clamp(.75 + .5 * damper_contact_energy, .75, 1.25)

results.name: create_string_modes.damper_node_coupling
results.expression: lerp(bass_damper_node, 1, transition((midi - 33) / 27))

results.name: create_string_modes.phase
results.expression: unison_phase(serial, (int)round(midi), string_index, string_count)

results.name: create_string_modes.cents
results.expression: string_count == 1 ? 0 : string_count == 2 ? (string_index == 0 ? -.47 : .53) * width_cents : (string_index == 0 ? -.83 : string_index == 1 ? -.34 : upper_detune) * width_cents

results.name: create_string_modes.polarization_cents
results.expression: (.35 + 1.1 * reg) * sin(2.17 * partial + 1.31 * string_index + .4)

results.name: create_string_modes.fast_amplitude
results.expression: weighted_amplitude * fast_fraction * vertical_second_partial_boost

results.name: create_string_modes.slow_amplitude
results.expression: weighted_amplitude * (1 - fast_fraction)

results.name: create_string_modes.polarization_amplitude
results.expression: weighted_amplitude * polarization_strength

results.name: create_impact_soundboard.impact_strength
results.expression: pow(velocity, 1.15) * (.82 + .18 * reg)

results.name: create_impact_soundboard.soft_contact_coupling
results.expression: pow(1 - velocity, 4)

results.name: create_impact_soundboard.slow_body_fraction
results.expression: low_body_mode ? body_mode_weight * (.2 * middle_body + .1 * treble_body * (1 + 2 * low_plate_weight)) * (1 - .98 * extreme_treble_body) : 0

results.name: create_impact_soundboard.felt_brightness
results.expression: pow(.58 + .42 * velocity, log2(high_frequency))

results.name: create_impact_soundboard.impact_radiation
results.expression: lerp(1, clamp(sqrt(frequency / 2000), .2, 1), reg * reg)

results.name: create_impact_soundboard.mid_plate_scale
results.expression: frequency >= 1800 && frequency < 3800 ? lerp(1, .18, extreme_treble) : 1

results.name: create_impact_soundboard.low_body_drive
results.expression: lerp(1, coupled_body_drive, body_mode_weight)

results.name: create_impact_soundboard.bass_high_plate_scale
results.expression: frequency >= 1800 ? lerp(.1, 1, bass_plate_transition) : 1

results.name: create_impact_soundboard.attack_drive
results.expression: drive * (2.5 * body_mode_weight * treble_body)

results.name: start_voice.bass_compensation
results.expression: 1 + .48 * clamp((45 - target->midi) / 24, 0, 1)

results.name: start_voice.bass_trim
results.expression: lerp(.25, 1, transition((target->midi - 21) / 27))

results.name: step_voice.lingering_felt
results.expression: felt_lowpassed * (1 - target->felt_rise_value) * target->felt_tail_value

results.name: step_voice.lingering_presence
results.expression: felt_presence * (1 - target->presence_rise_value) * target->presence_tail_value

results.name: step_voice.early_presence
results.expression: felt_presence * (1 - target->early_rise_value) * target->early_tail_value

results.name: step_voice.lingering_air
results.expression: felt_air * (1 - target->presence_rise_value) * target->presence_tail_value

results.expression: target->hammer_lowpass * collision

results.name: step_voice.mechanical_impact
results.expression: target->hammer_gains[8] * target->mechanical_lowpass * collision

results.name: step_voice.thump
results.expression: sin(TWO_PI * target->thump_frequency * strike_index / target->sample_rate) * target->thump_tail_value * (1 - target->thump_rise_value)
